theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_mi_measure_eq_withDensity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Θ : Euclid P → ℝ), R.Represents S → (∀ x : Euclid P, HasMassDensity S x (Θ x)) → R.measure = (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Θ x))
